revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Very uncomfortable with <:Μαρτυρίου|reg|Ματυ̣[ρ]ίου:>; it could be right but we can't impose an error on an ancient scribe iuxta lacunam (Youtie's law). Retaining Ματα̣[ε]ίου doesn't mean it's right; it's only that there is no better alternative. One could try <:Ματ.1[.1]ίου|alt|<:Μαρτυ[ρ]ίου|reg|Ματυ̣[ρ]ίου:>:>. The rest looks fine.
Submit - Changes and integrations of corrections in lines 5, 6, 12, 14, 18, 22, 23.

Commit - In summary, in line 5, I believe the name is a misspelled Μα<ρ>τυρίου (cf. other υρ). I feel uncomfortable with an unattested Ματαείου. In line 6, the papyrus has νουμου; in line 14, γιγνομένης with a gamma; For line 23 on the verso, after checking the image, I don't see any λα between the full name Κολλούθου and ἀπὸ. The final curly upsilon of Κολλούθου must have given the impression of a λα.

Commit - Added BL corrections to lines 1, 5(x2), 10, 18, 19, 20, and overhauled various other other things: Removed the unnecessary extras from lines <:(Φλ(αουίων))|reg|(Φλλ(αουίων)):>, 2 <:λαμπρο|reg|<:λαμπρρο|subst|λαμπροο:>:>((τάτων)) & (ἰνδι|^κ^|(τίωνος)), 10&23 (χρ(υσοῦ)) (ν|^ο^|(μισμάτιον)), l.17 (ἐπερωτη|^θ^|(εὶς))—the way the words are abbreviated doesn’t belong here. || Changed supralinear bars to diaereses in ll. 4 and 15. || Corrected accents: l.7 παρά σου → παρὰ σοῦ (cf. Smyth, GG §187 N.2); l.8 ἴδιάν → ἰδίαν; l.18 προκει(μένος) → προκεί(μενος). || Two textual points are being discussed elsewhere.
